LESSON: WORK

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.2: Work

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Work
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you work?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify three responsibilities given to human beings by God
2. demonstrate good stewardship by taking care of God’s creation
3. explain the causes of child labour today
4. explain the effects of child labour for protection of self and others

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.
